Hi Anna and Erik —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. We’d love to run a 45–60 minute demo next week that covers: live inference walkthrough, cost/latency tradeoffs, and a short Q&A focused on integration patterns.

Quick note on scheduling: we want to be mindful of local workweek/holiday constraints — Golden Week falls next week in parts of APAC and a few of your engineers indicated limited availability. US attendees are on Pacific time, and EU attendees (Erik) are in CET. Between DST differences and regional holidays, a single global slot is going to be hard to pick.

Proposed options (all times shown as local-to-region start / overlap plan):
- Option A: Single staggered session with staggered starts (US start 08:30 PT / EU joins 17:30 CET / APAC joins 01:30 JST the following day) — we’d keep the core demo within the first 40 minutes and have region-specific Q&A windows.
- Option B: Two regional sessions — EU + US overlap (12:00 PT / 21:00 CET) and a separate APAC session later in the week.
- Option C: Record the main demo for APAC and run a shorter live APAC Q&A at a convenient local hour.

Attached is a draft agenda and an availability ICS you can edit. Can you share preferred option and any hard blackout dates? If helpful, I can propose exact calendar slots after I sync with Marissa and Aditya offline.

Thanks —
Rachel
